identity.name: Divers Sixty-Five
identity.one_liner: The 2015 reissue of Oris's 1965 dive watch — 40mm, vintage proportions, the most-cited modern Oris diver before the Calibre 400.

narrative.story: The Divers Sixty-Five is the reissue of the 1965 Oris dive watch (ref. 6518), scaled to 40mm from the original 36mm. The Oris 733 caliber is a Sellita SW200-1 base with a 38-hour reserve. The domed sapphire crystal and the thin aluminum bezel give it a vintage profile that reads closer to a 1960s watch than any modern diver at the $2,200 price point. The Divers Sixty-Five is the most-cited Oris diver before the Calibre 400 era.
narrative.collector_notes: The Divers Sixty-Five is available in 36mm, 40mm, and 42mm. The 40mm is the most-cited size. The 733 caliber is Sellita-based; the later Calibre 400 version (2023) added the 5-day reserve.
